ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Image-left lobe exhibits a dominant white field with vertical dark streaks and patches. Image-right lobe is predominantly solid black with high-contrast white mottling and speckling localized at the distal lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate convergence angle of 45 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering into sharp, acute points at the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast brownish-white nodules (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and obliquely across the white field of the image-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lateral tips and visible linear rake marks on the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly white left lobe and predominantly black right lobe.
